author: Codex for Whetstorm
method: Original hand-authored vector geometry and gradients. No reference images, inherited artwork, or third-party assets were used.
purpose: Transparent layered mage HUD overlays; the fire, chrono, and frost variants share the same independently authored geometry and use distinct palettes.
historical_source: The full game contains fire-phoenix-v2.webp, chronomancy-phoenix-v2.webp, and frost-phoenix-v1.webp under public/ui/procs. Their licence was not found in CREDITS.md; these replacements do not alter their attribution or rights.
